instruction: A candid outdoor full shot of a sunny park with lush green grass and leafy trees. On the left, the woman with dark hair tied back (R4) wears a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans, laughing and facing to the right. On the right, the bald man (R2) wears a dark blue t-shirt and black pants, looking directly at her and smiling warmly. The two stand close together on the grass, facing each other in happy anticipation of a celebration. Bright natural sunlight filters through the trees, illuminating the scene with warm green tones and soft shadows.
elements: R4 is the one laughing while facing R2
R2 is the one looking directly at R4 and smiling warmly
R4 and R2 stand close together facing each other
R4 and R2 are in happy anticipation of a celebration
